source_snapshot.items: Network Validation Initial Environment Setup and trial run - Check Telemetry
source_snapshot.procedure: Run IB-Stress between node-1 and node-2; select UFM Telemetry Last 5 Minutes; inspect telemetry tables and curves.
source_snapshot.criteria: Curves display correctly without abnormal surges or drops.
source_snapshot.deepseek: Generic UFM live-counter check with unrelated subnet-merge risk.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: RPUC/CHANGED; exact panels, units, sampling, baseline, bounded load and raw time series are required.

historical_reviews.deepseek: Covers live telemetry only generically and omits the five-minute window and subjective curve oracle.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: Identifies the missing numerical definition for abnormal variation.
historical_reviews.related_cases: Row424 checks report/alarm generation; row426 resets and reads PHY information with IBDiagnet.

original_test_intent: Verify that selected UFM telemetry curves accurately and continuously represent a bounded two-node IB workload over the Last 5 Minutes window without unexplained spikes or dropouts.
original_method: Approve nodes/link, traffic profile and telemetry panel matrix; synchronize clocks; capture idle baseline; start finite IB-Stress; export raw samples for the exact five-minute window; correlate rates/counters to endpoints; quantify missing samples, discontinuities, spike/drop thresholds and steady-state variation; stop traffic and capture return to baseline.
manual_activity: Fabric owner approves traffic and curve oracle; operator confirms UFM panel identity and visible rendering.
safety_requirements: Bound load and monitor fabric health
Do not infer healthy curves visually without raw samples
Stop on link, thermal or fabric error
No topology change, log clear or automatic retry

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Generic page access is insufficient; its topology warning is unrelated.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Run the approved finite IB-Stress and export the named Last-5-Minutes series with endpoint counters and synchronized timestamps.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: IB-Stress and Last 5 Minutes retained; 'abnormal' remains pending until quantified.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Judge exported time series with defined gap, spike, drop, variance and endpoint-delta rules, supplemented by UI screenshots.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Replaces subjective visual inspection with a traceable numeric series while preserving the UI check.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A populated table alone does not prove curve continuity or correct rate behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Refresh aggregation and clock skew can resemble surges or gaps; workload transients must be separated from telemetry defects.

project_override_considerations: Owner defines panels, expected workload shape, aggregation and permissible startup/stop transients, missing-sample limit and endpoint-to-UFM tolerance.
expected_evidence: Raw five-minute series and UI curves

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: DeepSeek's subnet-merger warning is unrelated; Master and GPT V2 consistently define a five-minute telemetry curve review under traffic.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Static review complete; execution gated by exact metrics, traffic and numerical curve oracle.

engineering_decision_pending.question: Resolve Compatibility row425 Wistron-L12 Cluster-00007-V002: approve node/link and finite IB-Stress profile, exact UFM panels/metrics/units, five-minute sampling/clock rules, numeric surge/drop/gap/variation thresholds, endpoint correlation tolerance and allowed transients.

review_improvement: Converts 'looks correct' into an exportable, time-aligned continuity and accuracy assessment.
independent_technical_reasoning: A smooth curve may still be wrong if its units or link identity are wrong, while real workload startup can look like an abnormal surge. Raw synchronized samples and endpoint counters distinguish rendering, collection and workload effects.
